scope: Source-only five-fold training and validation on the exact E3 amended export; no outer test
loss: Exact supplied patient-equal weighted BCE; EZ:NEZ 2:1
checkpoint_selection: Validation mean patient EZ-AP; tie Macro-F1 at 0.5, then earlier epoch
threshold_selection: One threshold per fold; supplied 37-point 0.05..0.95 grid, validation Macro-F1, tie closest to 0.5 then higher threshold
primary_summary: Mean of five validation fold means, equivalently 65 patient-fold cells
paired_comparison: Frozen E3 minus E1; matched patient-fold cells; 10000 patient-ID cluster bootstrap draws, seed42, retaining each resampled patient's full cell set
runtime_caveat: E3 trained under NumPy2.2.6 and finalized under isolated1.26.4; E1 trains/finalizes under1.26.4 with unchanged Torch. Existing metrics/sampling/input/forward parity passed; disclose this engineering difference.
